explain.say: Do b and d ever swap places on you? They are like twins in mirror clothes. Lots of people mix them up, and there is a clever trick to help. Look at the two letters on the board.

explain.say: Here is the bed trick. Make two fists with your thumbs up. Push your knuckles together. Your left hand makes b and your right hand makes d. See? It looks like a bed!

The word bed starts with b and ends with d, just like your hand bed. When you are not sure, make your bed and check. Super work! Your brain learns in its own way, and lots of brilliant people learn like this.

faq.a: Make two fists with thumbs up and push your knuckles together. Your left hand makes b, your right hand makes d, and together they look like a bed.
asks: How does the bed trick work?

faq.a: Think bat and ball. The bat, the tall line, comes first. Then the ball, the bump, sits on the right.
Think drum and drumstick. The round drum comes first, then the tall stick. A d also starts with a c shape.

faq.q: Why do b and d get mixed up?
faq.a: They are the same shape, just flipped. Your brain is great at knowing a cup is a cup whichever way it faces, but letters change when they flip. Practice helps a lot.
asks: Why do I mix up b and d?

faq.q: What else helps with b and d?
faq.a: Trace big letters in sand or with your finger on the table, and say the sound as you trace. A teacher or grown-up can stick a little bed picture on your desk to check.
asks: More tips for b and d

facts: The letters b and d are mirror images of each other.
In the word bed, b comes first and d comes last, so the tall lines stand at each end like bedposts.

quiz.say: Which letter has the tall line first, then the bump?
quiz.show: Tall line first, then the bump?
quiz.why: b is bat, then ball: the tall line comes first.

wrong.1: d has the bump first, then the tall line.
wrong.2: p has a line first too, but its line hangs down below, not up tall.

quiz.say: In the bed trick, which hand makes d?
quiz.why: Your right hand makes d, the last letter of bed.

wrong.0: Your left hand makes b, the first letter of bed.
wrong.2: Each hand makes one letter: b on the left, d on the right.
